apps.name: USB Microscope
apps.tagline: Live view, zoom, LED and recording for cheap USB microscopes
apps.description: A PyQt5 app for cheap USB microscope cameras on Linux. Shows a live UVC video stream, a digital zoom slider, snapshot and video recording, crosshair/grid overlays, and auto-detected hardware controls (LED/illumination, hardware zoom, and other v4l2 controls) when the connected camera exposes them.
apps.author: JapySoft
